title: Data Collection Facts Label
text:
Data Source Facts Label














Source Identity






Source name


Access to Intercity Air, Bus, and Rail Transportation in Rural Areas




Domain/topic


Public Transportation




Source type


Government Dataset











Collection Context






Collector/producer


Bureau of Transportation Statistics




Original purpose


Public reporting




Collection method


GIS analysis using existing data from government and transportation databases




Record-creation event


Existence of a county deemed “rural” by the GIS analysis











Observation and Scope






Unit of observation


Each row represents one county and its rural public transporation access




Population or objects represented


Counties, airports, bus stops, and rail facilities




Time period covered


2006, 2012, 2018, and 2021




Geographic area coverage


Rural block groups in the United States











Variables and Data Structure






Main variables/fields


State, County, Land Area, Water Area, Population, Year, % Rural Access to Airport/Bus Stop/Rail Station




Data types included


Location, numerical, categorical, date, ID




Direct measurements


County population, transportation facility location, year




Possible proxy variables


% Rural Access to Airport/Bus Stop/Rail Station, Household income, Vehicles per household, Civilian labor force











Documentation






Documentation found


Methodology, metadata (column descriptions)




Stated collection details


Airport data gotten from FAA’s enplanement data and BTS’ Office of Airline Administration airport summary; Intercity bus stop data gotten from Greyhound, Amtrak, BTS’ June 2005 Rural Scheduled Intercity Transportation and the U.S. Rural Population report, BTS’ IPCD, and BTS’ Intercity Bus Atlas; Intercity rail facility data gotten from BTS’ Febuary 2011 U.S. Rural Population and Scheduled Intercity Transportation in 2010 report, BTS’ IPCD, BTS’ National Transportation Atlas Database, and Alaska railroad website; Population data gotten from the U.S. Census Bureau and American Community Survey
